main.description: Activate focus mode. Returns the oldest unread work notification so the client can navigate to it.

issueAt.description: AT-URI of the issue to navigate to, if the item is an issue.

notificationId.description: ID of the first notification to address. Absent if the queue is empty.

pullAt.description: AT-URI of the pull to navigate to, if the item is a pull.

repoDid.description: DID of the repository the item belongs to. Absent if the queue is empty.

errors.description: There are no unread work notifications to focus on.
errors.name: NoFocusItems
